definition: Unique Steam application ID for the game.
Game title listed on Steam.
Developer name listed by SteamSpy.
Publisher name listed by SteamSpy.
Release date as originally returned by the Steam Store.
Calendar year extracted from the Steam Store release date.
Years since release in 2026; same concept as game_age_years.
Years since release at collection year 2026, computed as 2026 minus release_year.
Squared game_age_years; used only for the non-linearity model check.
Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include Indie; equals 0 otherwise.
Equals 1 when the Steam Store marks the game as free-to-play; equals 0 for paid games.
Current listed price in USD; free games are coded as 0.
Base listed price in USD before any current discount, when available.
Natural log of 1 plus initial_price_numeric.
Natural log of 1 plus initial_price_numeric for paid games; free games are coded as 0 and handled separately with is_free.
Squared log_price_paid; used only for the non-linearity model check.
Current discount percentage reported by SteamSpy at collection time.
Number of positive Steam recommendations reported by SteamSpy.
Number of negative Steam recommendations reported by SteamSpy.
Total number of Steam recommendations, computed as positive plus negative.
Natural log of 1 plus total_reviews; main review-count engagement proxy used as the outcome.
Share of Steam reviews marked Recommended, computed as positive divided by total_reviews; ranges from 0 to 1.
Equals 1 when at least half of Steam reviews are Recommended; used for descriptive plots.
SteamSpy estimated owner range as text. This is estimated owners, not downloads or exact sales.
Legacy column name for the lower bound of the SteamSpy owner estimate.
Legacy column name for the upper bound of the SteamSpy owner estimate.
Lower bound of the SteamSpy estimated owner range.
Upper bound of the SteamSpy estimated owner range.
Midpoint of the SteamSpy estimated owner range. This is an estimate, not downloads or exact sales.
Natural log of 1 plus owners_midpoint; used as a robustness engagement proxy.
Current concurrent users reported by SteamSpy at collection time.
Average lifetime playtime reported by SteamSpy, in minutes when available.
Median lifetime playtime reported by SteamSpy, in minutes when available.
Equals 1 when the Steam Store lists Windows support.
Equals 1 when the Steam Store lists Mac support.
Equals 1 when the Steam Store lists Linux support.
Number of supported Steam desktop platforms among Windows, Mac and Linux; this does not measure mobile support.
Steam Store genres joined by vertical bars; these are Store genres, not Steam user tags.
Steam Store categories/features joined by vertical bars; these are Store feature labels, not Steam user tags.
Supported-language text as originally returned by the Steam Store.
Parsed supported languages joined by vertical bars.
Original approximate count of supported languages from the earlier cleaning pass.
Number of supported languages parsed from the Steam Store page.
Natural log of 1 plus language_count; used for the language-count predictor because language counts are skewed.

Equals 1 when French is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when German is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Spanish is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Simplified Chinese is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Japanese is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Korean is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Russian is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when Portuguese is listed as a supported language.
Equals 1 when at least one selected major non-English language is listed.
Equals 1 when at least one of Simplified Chinese, Japanese or Korean is listed. It does not mean the game supports most Asian languages.
Equals 1 when Steam Store categories include Single-player.
Equals 1 when Steam Store categories include Family Sharing.
Equals 1 when Steam Store categories indicate multiplayer or PvP support.
Equals 1 when Steam Store categories indicate co-op or Remote Play Together support.
Equals 1 when Steam Store categories mention controller or Steam Input support for PC play; this is not console-platform support.
Equals 1 when Store metadata indicates Early Access.
Equals 1 when the game lists Steam Achievements, meaning Steam-integrated achievement goals that players can unlock.
Equals 1 when the game lists Steam Cloud, meaning Steam can synchronize supported save files/settings across devices.
Equals 1 when the game lists Steam Trading Cards, collectible profile items players can receive and craft into badges.
Equals 1 when the game lists Steam Leaderboards, meaning Steam-integrated rankings for player scores or progress.
Equals 1 when total_reviews is in the top quartile of this sample; legacy descriptive engagement flag.
Equals 1 when has_multiplayer or has_coop equals 1; kept for description, not used with the separate components in the final model.

Equals 1 when Atmospheric appears in available Store genres/categories; exact Steam user tags were not collected.
Equals 1 when First-Person appears in available Store genres/categories; exact Steam user tags were not collected.

Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include Adventure; included because it appears in at least 50 games.
Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include Casual; included because it appears in at least 50 games.
Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include RPG; included because it appears in at least 50 games.
Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include Simulation; included because it appears in at least 50 games.
Equals 1 when Steam Store genres include Strategy; included because it appears in at least 50 games.
